remarks: This terrific loft style unit is turn-key perfect and spotless featuring brand new flooring, fresh paint and many recent updates. Enjoy an impressive vaulted ceiling, exposed brick, massive factory style windows, wood beams and abundant original character/charm. The kitchen is well appointed with stainless steel appliances, offers abundant workspace on gleaming granite counters, including a breakfast bar ideal for seating/entertaining. A first floor powder room is available for guests to use while there is a renovated full bathroom above in the loft. There is great closet storage on the first floor and above in the loft. Clocktower residents enjoy the use of a business center/conference room, newly outfitted gym, outdoor garden in the courtyard and an impressive recreation space that can be rented for private parties/events complete with a well appointed kitchen. This is a great place to call home! Excellent credit and references are a must. Pets will be considered with an excellent application on case by case basis.
